name: Water 2
description: v1's quark-model water: a 12×12 lattice of H2O molecules, oxygen as 24 up + 24 down quarks with 8 electrons and each hydrogen as a uud triplet 2.85 fm away at ±30° with its electron around it, bound by v1's powAXv3 nuclear force and Coulomb. Gravity (G ≈ 7e-39) is negligible and omitted.

forces.name: Nuclear (v1 powAXv3)
forces.expression: -k * n_i * n_j * sin(A * (1 - B^x)) * a * exp(-a * x)
